messages:
sara.prod: Heads-up: we need to finalise the dependency gating checklist for private packaging (on‑prem + airgap) before Q3 roadmap lock. Posting proposed gates below. Comments?

mike_pm: Thanks. Can we prioritize KMS/HSM integration checks? Several customers flagged FIPS/HSM as a blocker.

kevin_eng: From eng perspective we need three build artifacts: signed tarball, OCI image, and an offline installer. Offline installer must include a connectivityless preflight and a fallback path for missing kernel modules.

anita_legal: Licensing note — ensure distro packages and third-party binaries have SPDX identifiers and documented redistrib permissions. I need to review before we ship.

omar_sre: Acceptance criteria idea: run staging e2e with simulated network partition and verify rollback if 5xx > 0.5% during canary. Also telemetry must be off by default for airgapped installs.

deploy-bot: New build uploaded: nx-packaging-v0.9 (id: 2054327000). CI logs: /ci/packaging/2054327000 — basic packaging smoke passed.

sara.prod: Proposed gating checklist (draft snippet):
```
- Signed artifacts + provenance (GPG + timestamp)
- Offline installer integrity + checksums
- KMS/HSM integration test vectors (local + cloud KMS)
- Airgap certificate rotation procedure documented
- CVE scan: zero critical/high unresolved
- Telemetry and phoning-home disabled by default
- Export control + EULA signoff
- Installer idempotency & offline preflight
```
Agree or missing anything?

kevin_eng: Add: quantization table compatibility tests (we saw int8 path fail for one customer model), and ensure models directory layout is identical between OCI and offline installer. Also include an automated install smoke that runs with CPU-only resources.

mike_pm: Prioritization note: if HSM integration looks like >2 sprints, propose we ship with "documented workaround + paid integration" as fallback so we don't block roadmap. We can re-prioritise based on incoming enterprise deals.

anita_legal: :thumbsup: that fallback is fine. I'll add export-control checklist and EULA updates to the legal tasks. Need to know any non-open license blobs included.

omar_sre: Ops gates to add: healthcheck returns 200 within 2s, bootstrap without kube DNS (static hosts), local log rotation for airgap, and canary metrics (errors, latency p50/p95, memory growth).

sara.prod: Action items and owners: Kevin to prototype offline preflight + quant table tests by Tue, Mike to re-scope HSM story and add fallback wording, Anita to prepare legal checklist draft, Omar to author canary metrics + failure thresholds. Sync Thurs 11:00AM in #product-planning. @kevin_eng @mike_pm @anita_legal @omar_sre

kevin_eng: On it — I'll drop a PoC link and a tiny installer script before EOD Monday.

mike_pm: I'll add a short blurb into the roadmap doc under "Private packaging - gating" and mark OKR impact. Link (internal): https://redwood.internal/roadmap/private-packaging

sara.prod: Thanks all. If you have any customer-specific must-haves (e.g., specific HSM vendors, distro requests), paste them here so we can fold into the checklist. Closing the thread after Thurs sync unless something urgent pops up.
